# NexHSE Africa

> NexHSE Africa helps organisations across Kenya and Africa protect people, reduce workplace risk and build practical HSE capability.

## Primary resources

- [Services](https://nexhseafrica.co.ke/services): Full 24-service workplace safety, training, equipment and environmental portfolio.
- [HSE FAQs](https://nexhseafrica.co.ke/faqs): Common questions about workplace safety, fire safety, training, audits and environmental management.
- [Knowledge hub](https://nexhseafrica.co.ke/knowledge): HSE knowledge notes and practical guidance.
- [Blog](https://nexhseafrica.co.ke/blog): Workplace safety, fire, risk, training and environmental insights.
- [Training](https://nexhseafrica.co.ke/training): Workplace HSE training and professional development programmes.
- [Contact](https://nexhseafrica.co.ke/contact): Head office, Nairobi, Kenya and enquiry details.
- [Sitemap](https://nexhseafrica.co.ke/sitemap.xml): Complete indexable URL map.

## Topics

Workplace health and safety, OSH training, fire safety, first aid, work at height, confined spaces, emergency response, PPE, risk assessments, health and safety audits, OSH policies, construction site safety, firefighting equipment, environmental impact assessment, waste management, effluent and emissions management.

## AI access

For structured read-only discovery, use the NexHSE MCP endpoint at `https://nexhseafrica.co.ke/api/mcp` when your AI client supports MCP Streamable HTTP. Available tools cover the service portfolio, HSE FAQs, and knowledge/blog articles.
